description: This file defines a durable, serializable list data structure with versioned command-based log application and snapshot management, aimed at persistence and resilience in stateful systems. It includes interfaces, a concrete class, and debugging views related to durable list management within Orleans framework.

classes.name: IDurableList`1
classes.description: Generic interface for a durable list supporting range addition and read-only view.

classes.name: DurableList`1
classes.description: Implementation of a durable, versioned list supporting serialization, command application, and snapshotting in Orleans.

classes.name: IDurableCollectionDebugView`1
classes.description: Debugger view class for inspecting collections.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an item to the list and logs the change.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the list and logs the clear command.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if the list contains a specified item.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies the list items to an array.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator for the list.

methods.name: IndexOf
methods.description: Finds the index of an item.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts an item at a specified index and logs the insertion.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of a specific item.

methods.name: RemoveAt
methods.description: Removes the item at a specified index and logs the removal.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a log entry to update the list state.

methods.name: ApplySnapshot
methods.description: Applies a snapshot of the list state.
